subject: general
question: India won eight Olympic gold medals in which sport till 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __Field Hockey__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's team won eight gold medals in 1928, 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, 1964, and 1980.

 
 
• India also has the best overall performance in Olympic history with 83 victories out of the 134 matches played.
 
• They are also the only team to ever win the Olympics without conceding a single goal in 1928 and 1956.
 
• In 1928, the team won its first Olympic gold medal and until 1960, the Indian men's team remained unbeaten in the Olympics, winning six gold medals in a row.
 
• India also won the World Cup in 1975.
 
• India won eight Olympic gold medals in which sport till 2020.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 2022 Winter Olympic Games' award ceremony took place at Beijing's National Stadium, also referred to as the Bird's Nest, on February 20, 2022.
 
• The Games included 109 events in all, spread over 15 disciplines, in 7 different sports.
 
• The Game's venues were spread up among three zones: Beijing, Yanqing, and Zhangjiakou. 
 
• For the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy, the Games' Presidency has officially been transferred. 
 
• Beijing is on track to make history by being the first city to ever host both the summer and winter Olympics.
